description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio for SDPA output, comparing values before and after gating. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A dashed orange line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003”, begins at approximately 0.8 at layer 0 and declines to approximately 0.003 at layer 20. A dotted brown line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126”, begins at approximately 0.12 at layer 0 and declines to approximately 0.002 at layer 20. A dashed green line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080”, begins at approximately 0.22 at layer 0 and declines to approximately 0.002 at layer 20.
